m: 1. कुप् cl. 4. P. Ā. कुप्यति, ˚ते (perf. चुकोप), to be moved or excited or agitated, Suśr.; BhP.; to swell, heave or boil with rage or emotion, be angry, be angry with (dat.; also gen., once [R. i, 49, 7] acc.; or with उपरि and gen., e.g. तस्मै or तस्य or तस्योपरि चुकोप, he was angry with him), MBh. &c.: Caus. P. कोपयति, to move, shake, agitate, RV. i, 54, 4; v, 57, 3; x, 44, 8; Suśr.; P. Ā. कोपयति, ˚ते, to cause to swell with anger, provoke, make angry, MBh. &c.;
कुप् [cf. Lat. cupio; Eng. hope; Germ. hoffe.]
2. कुप् cl. 10. P. कोपयति, ‘to speak’ or ‘to shine’, Dhātup. xxxiii, 106;
कुप् [cf. Hib. cubhas, ‘word, promise’, Lat. nun-cupo; Goth. huf, ‘to lament’.]
a: कुप् — {vI.v} {c4c} P. (कुप्यति, चुकोप, अकुपत्, कोपितुं, कुपित) 1 To be angry, (generally with the dat. of the person who is the object of anger, but sometimes with the acc. or gen. also); कुप्यतिं हितवादिने K. 108; कुपितश्चंद्रगुप्तश्चाणक्यस्योपरि Mu. 2; M. 3. 21; U. 7; चुकोप तस्मै स भृशं R. 3. 56. --2 To be excited, to gather strength, be virulent; as in दोषाः प्रकुप्यंति Suśr. --Caus. (कोपयति-ते) 1 To provoke, irritate; to excite, agitate. --2 To stir up. {vII.v} {c10c} U. 1 To shine. --2 To speak.
